headline: Belgium Government on Hold as Budget Row Splits Coalition Over Deficit
summary: King Philippe is weighing Prime Minister De Wever's resignation offer after a $11 billion budget gap and a 5.4% deficit forecast split the governing coalition.
why: Political instability and fiscal deficits in European nations can weigh on sovereign credit ratings, debt yields, and investor confidence in regional currency stability.

impacts.name: Belgium
impacts.why: Political gridlock and large budget deficits create sovereign fiscal risk.
